identification: Ovation roundback (Lyrachord bowl) electric-acoustic guitar in hard case. Spruce top, leaf-pattern rosette, diamond fret markers, Ovation banjo-style headstock logo, black Lyrachord bowl with a single volume knob and jack (onboard pickup/preamp), no cutaway. Looks like a Balladeer-family model (1111/1112/1612 type), exact model/serial not visible. Estimate 250-350, current bid $220. Photo 5 (_7) shows a dollhouse bedroom set, not the guitar (catalogue photo mix-up).

Check: bowl cracks, top lifting, neck angle, working pickup/preamp (knob and jack on bowl), frets, case latches. Model/serial label inside the soundhole is not shown, so confirm the model in person; 1111/1112 era sold roughly A$300-1,000 in 2023-26, middle ~A$500-800 when in good order.
